title: Round-0 regression fix: make an incommensurable metric subtraction unrepresentable
question: exp5766's CEGIS round 0 scored 6.33x below its own matched single-shot control (exp5764). Is the induction mechanism regressed, and what is the fix?
answer: The mechanism is not regressed and the 6.33x is not a mechanism measurement. exp5764 prompts on the WHOLE window and grades on the WHOLE window (in-sample fit); exp5766 round 0 prompts on the first two thirds and grades on the disjoint last third (out-of-sample). Both record the value under the field name heldout_accuracy, and exp5766 subtracted one from the other. Scored like-for-like the arms are not distinguishable. The fix is a guard at the subtraction plus an append-only corrigendum voiding the comparison; the underlying per-cell data is real and is retained.

correction_to_the_confirmation.what_i_changed: The confirmation proposed keying the guard on the metric's ROW SET (whole_window / disjoint_tail / prompt_overlapping_prefix) and refusing when the tags differ. Implemented literally, that guard refuses the CORRECT like-for-like comparison it itself identified -- exp5764's whole_window (0.378487) against exp5766's prompt_overlapping_prefix (0.319444) -- because those are two different row sets.
correction_to_the_confirmation.the_fix: The guard keys on the RELATION each score stands in to its prompt evidence (in_sample / out_of_sample). whole_window and prompt_overlapping_prefix are both in_sample, so their comparison is permitted; disjoint_tail is out_of_sample, so subtracting it from either is refused.
correction_to_the_confirmation.why_it_matters: A guard that blocks the right answer along with the wrong one teaches people to switch it off. This is pinned by test_on_permits_the_correct_like_for_like_comparison and proven non-decorative by mutation 3.
correction_to_the_confirmation.second_minor_correction: The confirmation reports the like-for-like split as '6 wins / 5 losses / 2 ties'. Recomputed, 6 games favour exp5766's prefix and 5 favour exp5764 with 2 ties -- the same numbers, listed treatment-first. Not a discrepancy; noted so a future reader does not chase one.

honest_limits.availability_is_not_delivery: The guard has ZERO shipped call sites. The only site that made this mistake is a completed experiment, and re-running it is not on the table. This is a library plus a scope registry for future comparators -- it is NOT currently firing on any live path, and no claim is made that it is.
honest_limits.residual_effect_not_zero: The like-for-like gap is 1.18-1.29x. It is NOT claimed to be nil -- only that this data cannot distinguish the arms. It is smaller than the harness's own documented cell-level nondeterminism (sampling_seed returns None absent CARNOT_ARC_GENERATOR_SEED; fresh sampler seed per call at temperature 0.2), and its sign is what the one-third evidence handicap predicts.
not_fixed_here_and_owned_elsewhere: unfalsifiable zeros: 4 of 13 games have a held-out tail whose only row is the level-up row, which WorldModelVerifier.score excludes, so n_correct / max(1, n) returns 0.0 for every possible engine. Fixing it changes what min_heldout_accuracy admits on the LIVE trust gate -- out of scope for a round-0 metric fix.

gate band not expressible: tails carry 0-3 gradeable rows so delta_heldout moves in steps of 1/n while the pre-registration is written in units of 0.15 and 0.05. Needs an operator design decision (enlarge the window, or restate the gate in units of 1/n).
the refactor write-path collapse and the refinement purity leak are owned by other work and were not touched.
honest_limits.retirement_not_acted_on: exp5766's retire_if_same_verdict is conditioned on HONEST-NEGATIVE and the run landed partial_inconclusive, so its stated precondition was never met. This is RECORDED in the corrigendum, not acted on: the retirement also rests on two defects owned elsewhere, and the conductor's consumption path for that field was not traced here.
honest_limits.offline_is_not_behavioural: Nothing here measures plans, actions or levels. It concerns how two recorded scalars may be compared.

field_principles.inference_substrate: aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts -- this change loads no model and runs no game; it re-derives numbers from two committed shards and ships a library plus tests. Declaring live inference would invite a duration floor calibrated for GPU work this never did.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal-prefixed so the conductor's reconciler classifies it as terminal rather than retrying a completed fix.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: sha256 of the shipped module, so a third party can tell whether the code they are reading is the code these mutation results describe.
field_principles.solve_provenance: development_proxy -- no live agent, no hidden game, no solve claimed.

concurrency_incidents_observed_and_handl.note: Three other writers were active in this tree throughout (carnot-conductor.service plus at least two agent workflows). Recorded because each of these is the exact class of damage the Test-Run Record Integrity Discipline exists to catch, and two of them nearly landed.

1_foreign_git_add_A_swallowed_the_index.what: After staging exactly 5 explicit paths, a re-check of git diff --cached showed 64 files / 4878 insertions / 197 deletions staged -- another writer had run git add -A between the stage and the commit.
1_foreign_git_add_A_swallowed_the_index.would_have_published: two other agents' in-flight test files (863 and 886 lines), ~40 test-suite-rewritten results artifacts, and the determination-field losses on experiment_4162 / experiment_4170 / experiment_696 that determination_preservation_lint was flagging
1_foreign_git_add_A_swallowed_the_index.action: git reset (index only, working tree untouched so no other writer lost work), then re-added the same 5 explicit paths and re-verified the volume
1_foreign_git_add_A_swallowed_the_index.detected_by: the mandated git diff --cached --stat volume check, not by any hook

2_record_damage_found_and_REPAIRED.classification: genuine record damage, not authored work -- no key was added or removed, only measured floats changed, which is the canonical signature of an experiment module's main() running under test collection
